output.review_comment: The changes appear logically sound and well-reasoned, but the PR lacks critical verification evidence. Before merging, please provide: (1) test output/logs showing all 10 tests passing, (2) the relevant docstring content to verify the cap/minimum logic interpretation, and (3) clarification of which tests were failing before these changes. The restructured cap/minimum logic is particularly critical—the new behavior of "apply minimum only when fee ≤ cap" differs from the old approach and should be explicitly validated against the docstring.
